title: Error handling in the API client

questions.question: How should `fetchUser` report failures to its callers?

options.label: Result type (Recommended)
options.description: Return a discriminated union. Callers must handle both branches.

options.label: Throw
options.description: Throw an `ApiError`. Matches what `fetch` callers expect.

options.label: Callback
Null on failure
options.preview:
```ts
const user = await fetchUser(id)
if (!user) return
render(user)
```

Simplest, but callers can't tell *not found* from *network down*.
